purpose: Define the canonical result produced by a new dependent validation run after a property evidence fixture change.
rules: The revalidation result must reference a new validation run.
The new run must not replace or mutate the historical run that triggered the revalidation.
Every required dependent test must have an explicit result.
Proposition scope must remain limited to the propositions mapped to the fixture dependency.
Synthetic fixtures cannot produce real-world property conclusions.
Source-derived fixtures require provenance appropriate to their declared source.
A critical dependency failure blocks closure.
Passing revalidation does not establish legal-source verification or publication readiness.
guardrails: This contract governs technical revalidation output only.
It does not determine the truth of Irish property law.
It cannot represent live official-record retrieval.
It cannot convert a synthetic fixture into production evidence.
Publication remains subject to separate legal-source, evidence and privacy gates.
